text: On 4 May CNC-02 stopped at about 0039 with SP104 on the screen. Grinding noise from spindle, vibration alarm. When I opened it up I found spindle bearing wear on the spindle. I replaced BRG 7014 ACD x2 and KLB2 grease and SEAL SPDL 70. Next time check the spindle first. Please tell the next shift if it comes back.
